tokens-none: at least one: name a token postpaid_config lists
tokens-too-many: more than are accepted: name each once, from postpaid_config's list
params-operation: two parameters, by position: the user operation and its EntryPoint
quote-no-call: missing: the call, or its data's length
quote-no-gas: missing: needed with only the call's length; or give the call whole
authority-undelegated: needed: {authority} isn't delegated yet, so the call can't be run to estimate it; give gas, or sign the authorization and quote with authorizationList
authority-and-list: with authorizationList: give one or the other
call-length-mismatch: {given}, but the call's data is {length}. Leave callDataLength out with the call
gas-over: over {most}, the most a call may be given
call-too-long: over {most} bytes, the most a call's data may be
transaction-over: the transaction needs {needs}, over {most}: give the call less gas, or split it into smaller calls
verify-gas-no-payer: only with a payer: name the payer, or leave verifyGas out
factory-fails: its factory call fails: {why}. Check the factory and its data, or leave the deployment out if the account exists
deadline-far: over {ahead} blocks ahead: name an earlier block
valid-after: not valid by the next block: sign it valid from now
valid-before: passed: sign the transfer valid for longer
transfer-not-payment: the transfer isn't the payment: its to must be the payee, and its value the amount
token-suspended: {token} is suspended. Pay in another token postpaid_config lists, or try again later
no-eip3009: {token} takes no EIP-3009 transfer: pay in a token x402 takes, or have the call pay for itself
deployment-not-signatures: not the one the payment's signature deploys: name that one, or none
authorization-r-s: r or s out of range
authorizations-over: over {most}: send at most that many
authorization-chain: chain id {chain_id}: sign it for this chain, or for any (0)
paymaster-fields: none, but its other fields given: name the paymaster, or leave its fields out
paymaster-pays-by-fees: zero: an op with a paymaster pays the relay by its fees
fees-pay-nothing: pays nothing a gas as the base fee may fall
fees-estimated: above zero: an op paying by its fees is priced by its estimate
limits-given: none: a signed op gives its limits
operation-pays-nothing: pays the relay's payee nothing, in any token it takes. End its calls with a payment to the payee of what postpaid_quoteUserOperation quotes
eip7702-unsigned: none, and the sender isn't delegated: add the sender's signed authorization
signature-refused: {whose} doesn't take its signature: sign the op's hash for this EntryPoint and chain
underpaid: underpaid: {required} of {token} is required. Sign the payment again for at least that, and send it again
no-capacity: no capacity: the queue is full. A payment of at least {required} of {token} would be taken: pay that, or try again in a few blocks
not-accepted: {token} isn't accepted: postpaid_config lists the tokens taken
eth-not-accepted: ETH isn't accepted here, and an op paying by its fees pays in it. Pay by the op's calls instead (maxFeePerGas 0)
suspended: {token} is suspended: {why}. Pay in another token postpaid_config lists, or try again later
wrong-payee: the payee is {payee}, not {given}. Pay the payee postpaid_config names
unknown-submission: no submission {id}: unknown here, or finished long enough ago to be forgotten. Check the id, or submit it again
not-measured: not measured yet: its nodes didn't answer
unknown-fork: a fork no schedule knows: a plain call costs {gas}
unknown-fee-formula: an OP-stack fee formula Bruno doesn't know: its oracle answers otherwise
block-unseen: the nodes aren't at block {block} yet
node-failed: a node failed. Try again in a few seconds
next-retry: Try again in a few seconds
next-operator: Only the relay's operator can fix this: use another relay meanwhile
no-x402: chain {chain} takes no x402 payments: pay through postpaid_sendTransaction, or on a chain that does: see /
revert-underpaid: the payee gained less than the payment's amount during the call. Make the call pay it, or pay by a signed transfer
revert-gas-exhausted: the call couldn't be given its gas. Quote the call again for its gas
revert-balance-unreadable: the payment token's balance couldn't be read. Pay in another token
revert-failed-op: the EntryPoint refused the op: "{text}". Check its signature and nonce, and that its account, or its paymaster, can pay for it
revert-error: the call reverted: "{text}". The call is made by a one-off contract, so that's its msg.sender, not your account: a call moving your account's tokens must come from the account itself (its EIP-7702 delegate, or a smart account), or pay by an EIP-3009 transfer instead
revert-panic: the call panicked (0x{code}). The call is made by a one-off contract, so that's its msg.sender, not your account: a call moving your account's tokens must come from the account itself (its EIP-7702 delegate, or a smart account), or pay by an EIP-3009 transfer instead
revert-empty: the call reverted, saying nothing. The call is made by a one-off contract, so that's its msg.sender, not your account: a call moving your account's tokens must come from the account itself (its EIP-7702 delegate, or a smart account), or pay by an EIP-3009 transfer instead
revert-other: the call reverted with error {selector}. The call is made by a one-off contract, so that's its msg.sender, not your account: a call moving your account's tokens must come from the account itself (its EIP-7702 delegate, or a smart account), or pay by an EIP-3009 transfer instead
x402-no-call: the body isn't a call: post the call (to, data) and, if you know it, its gas, for its price
x402-no-signature: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE is required: sign a transfer for one of these and send it with the same body
x402-token: {token} isn't accepted over x402: pay in one the 402 lists
x402-value: value isn't the amount {amount}: sign the transfer for exactly accepted.amount
x402-finished: {status}: {why}. Pay again, at the price this 402 asks
